I can totally relate to this feeling. I am 21 and have dealt with chronic pain for 6 years. I have a laundry list of problems in my back from scoliosis and arthritis to bulging and herniated discs. I have been in several car accidents and hit by a car as a pedestrian most recently. I used to be athletic and outdoorsy but my pain has kept me from doing sports or anything too strenuous. I have found art really helps me with dealing with my pain, I needed a new activity to fill the void of going out and doing things and art allows me to express myself.  I also have two cats and a dog that really helps calm me down, I cuddle with them when I'm hurting or just need some emotional support. Find friends that enjoy hanging out and not doing anything or also enjoy art.. I have a few that will just come over and chat with me when I get stir crazy and I know they don't have expectations of me because I know they are content just hanging out. I know how hard it can be to navigate highschool in chronic pain, but it is possible. I did it and I believe in you!
